notes: FlightLine: Start session. One button starts your flight programs one after another (MSFS 2024, SayIntentions, Navigraph, SimBrief…) and switches the panel to your flight page.
End session switches the panel back, and closes only the programs you ticked.
Edit the list in FlightLine → Session. Start it from FlightLine, Control Hub → Projects, or a panel button (Quick actions).
Finding the airports for a flight is quicker and lighter.
